issues_remediated.name: Stale / Incorrect Shipment Response
issues_remediated.root_cause: Missing shipment keyword patterns in ai/intent.py and unconditional context slot merging hijacking intent classification into PRODUCT_INQUIRY.
issues_remediated.fix_description: Added natural shipment phrasing rules, isolated context slot inheritance to explicit query intent, added get_customer_orders lookup for shipment resolution.

issues_remediated.name: Product MRP Zero Value Data Loss
issues_remediated.root_cause: MySQL products database table schema missing mrp DECIMAL(10,2) column definition.
database_changes: ALTER TABLE products ADD COLUMN mrp DECIMAL(10,2) NULL AFTER price;
issues_remediated.fix_description: Updated DDL schema and migration script, altered live MySQL products table, and re-migrated ShopKart JSON dataset.
